items.text: Hello Players, One Piece Pirate Warriors 4 is now available, and we’d like to thank you all for your support.
We regret that some of you are experiencing saving issues.
A patch is on the way, meanwhile we invite players affected by this issue to try the fix below:

1. Right-click on 'ONE PIEC PIRATE WARRIORS 4' in the Steam Client, then navigate to 'Manage' -> 'Browse Local Files', and right-click on OPPW4.EXE, and choose 'Properties' -> 'Compatibility', and check 'Run this program as administrator', then click 'Apply'.
2. Start 'ONE PIEC PIRATE WARRIORS 4' via the Steam Client, and play until you receive the 'Failed to save' error.
3. Go to 'C:\Users' (Change 'C' to whichever drive letter Windows uses)
4. Find a folder named 'Ïîëüçîâàòåëü' or similar, then navigate to the 'AppData' folder inside
5. Find the 'Local', which should contain the 'BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment'

6. Copy the 'BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment' folder to 'C:\Users\ [Your Username] \AppData\Local', resulting in a folder path similar to 'C:\Users\ [Your Username] \Appdata\Local\BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment'

In case you get *not enough space to save* issue - you can try to fix this either by freeing some space on a drive where your *Users* folder is located ( and Windows as well usually ), or Right-Click on your game in steam library - Properties - Local Files - Verify Integrity of Game Files. It should work in most cases.
